script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Arjun from SunPeak Solar, about the solar calculator you used on our website. Can you talk now?

scripts.en-IN: May I know your name, please?

stages.name: House and roof
stages.instruction: Ask whether they own the house, then what the roof is: concrete, sheet or tiles.

scripts.en-IN: Roughly how much is your electricity bill each month?

stages.name: Site survey
stages.instruction: Offer a free site survey and note the day they prefer; say the engineer will confirm it.

scripts.en-IN: We can send an engineer for a free site survey. Which day suits you?

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Thank them and say the engineer will confirm the survey.

scripts.en-IN: Thank you. Our engineer will call to confirm the survey.

step_outcomes.outcome: Whether they own the house and the roof type are known.
The person knows the engineer will confirm.
